name: routing_v5
instructions: A customer of a digital bank sent this message to support chat. Which specific issue is the message about? Pick the single option that best matches the customer's main request.

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment/purchase, or any transaction or money on the account, that the customer says they did not make or don't recognise (including money appearing that they didn't put there)
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash/ATM withdrawal the customer says they did not make or don't recognise
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: Any problem with a direct debit: one the customer doesn't recognise or didn't authorise, or wants refunded/reversed
criteria.compromised_card: Card or account may be compromised / used by someone else; wants to freeze because of suspicious activity
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost or stolen, reporting it, what to do; found a lost card
criteria.pin_issues: PIN: changing or resetting the PIN, PIN blocked, wrong PIN, where to change PIN, ATMs for PIN change
criteria.card_swallowed: ATM kept / swallowed / took the card
criteria.passcode_forgotten: App passcode forgotten, passcode not working, can't log into the app
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund for a purchase or to cancel a purchase / changed mind about an item; merchant goods not received
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund from a merchant has not appeared yet
criteria.charged_twice: Duplicate charge: charged twice / multiple times for the same purchase
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: ATM dispensed less cash than requested / wrong amount of cash received
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_on_transaction: The exchange rate the customer got on a payment or cash withdrawal seems wrong or different from what they expected
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was reverted/cancelled/returned unexpectedly
criteria.dispute_transaction: Wants to dispute or reverse a specific charge (not claiming it is fraud)
criteria.card_arrival: New card hasn't arrived, card delivery time, tracking the card delivery, delivery to a date/country
criteria.order_card: Ordering a physical card, a new/replacement card, extra or spare cards, card about to expire
criteria.virtual_card: Getting a virtual or disposable virtual card, their limits, virtual card not working
criteria.card_linking: Linking/adding a card to the app, making a card show up in the app
criteria.card_not_working: Card not working, contactless not working, card frozen
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment was declined or rejected
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM cash withdrawal declined / ATM didn't let me get cash
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is still pending / not showing
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Which card brand (Visa or Mastercard) the bank issues to the customer; getting or choosing a Visa/Mastercard card from the bank
criteria.card_acceptance_and_atms: Where the card is accepted, which ATMs can be used, card spending limits
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which types of cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, credit cards, other cards) can be used to add money / top up, what cards and currencies are supported
criteria.top_up: Topping up / adding money to the account: by card, bank transfer, cash, cheque, Apple Pay or Google Pay, auto top-up, top-up limits, how/where to top up
criteria.top_up_problem: Top-up pending, failed, declined, reverted, or money from top-up missing
criteria.verify_top_up: Top-up verification code / why a top-up needs verifying
criteria.cheque_or_cash_deposit_not_showing: Deposited cash or cheque but balance not updated
criteria.transfer_into_account: Transferring money into the account, receiving money, how to get paid
criteria.transfer_status: Transfer pending, timing, not received by recipient, balance not updated after bank transfer
criteria.transfer_failed: Transfer failed, declined, beneficiary not allowed
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancel a transfer, or a payment/transfer sent to the wrong account that needs to be corrected
criteria.sending_money: How to make transfers, SWIFT, transfer types
criteria.card_payment_fee: Fees on card payments: why was I charged a fee for paying by card or for a purchase, why do some of my payments have fees
criteria.cash_withdrawal_fee: Fee charged for ATM / cash withdrawal
criteria.transfer_fee: Fee charged for a transfer or for receiving money
criteria.top_up_fee: Fee for topping up by card or bank transfer
criteria.exchange_rate: General questions about how exchange rates are set or what the current rates are (not a complaint that a rate was wrong)
criteria.exchange_in_app: How to exchange currency in the app, supported fiat currencies
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra charge (often an extra £1/$1) showing on the statement or in the app that the customer doesn't understand
criteria.verify_identity: Identity verification: documents needed, why it's needed, verification not working, app can't recognise me
criteria.age_and_country: Age limit, which countries are supported, eligibility to open an account
criteria.buy_crypto: Trying to purchase/buy cryptocurrency in the app (not topping up or transferring)
